highlights: Safer burns: a held Enter can't resume a paused job, a network laser stops if the window crashes, a laser left on delays shutdown, Abort restores the origin even on $10=0, and Reconnect waits for the job.

Machine Setup's Save switches to that machine's driver. A laser with laser mode off is asked to turn it on, one 1.0.29 saved as a CNC is asked before Start, and a controller locked before connecting is offered Reset.

Beginner help: plain wording from first run to Job complete, a Before you start safety check, a first-burn lesson and cut test, Cut last warnings for each part, and a wider Ctrl+K search with Keyboard Shortcuts.

Logos: white parts are cut out on SVG import, older logos are offered it, and Re-import keeps settings. SVG CSS transforms, DXF and HPGL arcs import as drawn, and phone photos preview at their burn grid.

Large jobs prepare in the background with progress and Leave Preview. Photo, Trace and text work run off the screen thread, big selections and pans stay smooth, and GRBL job times are closer to the real burn.

Recover unsaved work lists each session once and never clears a newer copy. Screen readers hear job changes and dialogs take focus. CNC Preview shows when adaptive clearing falls back; height maps carve their true surface.
